testimonial_reviews.rahul: Очень точный и простой в использовании калькулятор возраста. Интерфейс чистый, современный и профессиональный.
testimonial_reviews.priya: Простой интерфейс и мгновенный результат. Особенно понравилось, что он отлично работает на телефоне.
testimonial_reviews.amit: AgeVerse делает расчеты дат невероятно простыми. Быстрые результаты и отличный опыт.

faqs.a1: AgeVerse — это профессиональная платформа калькуляторов возраста, дат и повседневных задач, созданная для предоставления быстрых и точных результатов.
faqs.a2: AgeVerse точно рассчитывает возраст в годах, месяцах и днях на основе выбранных пользователем дат.
faqs.a3: Да. Основные калькуляторы AgeVerse бесплатны для использования.
faqs.a4: AgeVerse создан с учетом конфиденциальности. Введенная информация используется только для получения результата и не сохраняется лишний раз.
faqs.q5: Могу ли я использовать AgeVerse на мобильном телефоне?
faqs.a5: Да. AgeVerse адаптирован для работы на смартфонах, планшетах и настольных компьютерах.
faqs.a6: Количество языков в AgeVerse не ограничено. Новые языки можно добавлять через локальные переводы без изменения компонентов.

about_page.mission_text: Our mission is to make everyday calculations clear, accessible and convenient through carefully designed tools that are easy to use on any device.
about_page.tools_text: AgeVerse brings together practical calculators for different everyday needs.
about_page.category_age: Calculate age, date differences, events and retirement timelines with clear results.
about_page.category_health: Explore useful health-related calculations such as BMI, BMR, calories, nutrition and water needs.
about_page.category_family: Useful family-focused tools, including pregnancy timeline calculations.
about_page.category_utility: Everyday utility and financial calculators for conversions, percentages, GST, EMI, discounts and investments.
about_page.category_pet: A simple educational tool for estimating your dog's age and human-age equivalent.
about_page.why_text: AgeVerse focuses on clarity, convenience and a consistent experience across devices.
about_page.accurate_text: Our calculators use clearly defined calculation methods and present results in an easy-to-understand format.
about_page.simple_text: Clean interfaces help you enter information quickly and understand your results without unnecessary complexity.
about_page.privacy_text: AgeVerse is designed with privacy in mind and aims to minimize unnecessary collection of information.
about_page.languages_text: AgeVerse supports multiple languages so users can access its tools in a language they are comfortable with.
about_page.cta_text: Explore the AgeVerse calculators and find the tool you need.

contact_page.title: Связаться с AgeVerse
contact_page.intro: We value your feedback, suggestions and questions. Your input helps us improve the AgeVerse experience.
contact_page.feedback_text: Tell us what you like, what could be improved, or which calculator you would like to see next.
contact_page.support_text: If you notice a calculation, display or usability issue, please share the relevant details so it can be reviewed.
contact_page.contact_text: For general questions about AgeVerse, its calculators or the website, you can contact the AgeVerse team.
contact_page.email_text: Please use the official AgeVerse contact email for questions, feedback or support requests.
contact_page.cta_title: Thank you for helping AgeVerse improve.
contact_page.cta_text: Your feedback helps us create a better and more useful calculation experience.

privacy_page.title: Политика конфиденциальности
privacy_page.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how AgeVerse approaches information, privacy and the use of its website and calculators.
privacy_page.information_text: Information entered into calculators is used to provide the requested calculation and is not intended to be unnecessarily stored by the calculator itself.
privacy_page.data_storage_text: AgeVerse aims to minimize unnecessary storage of information. Some technical or service-related information may be processed by hosting, security, analytics or other website infrastructure providers.
privacy_page.analytics_text: AgeVerse may use analytics tools to understand website usage, improve performance and identify areas that need improvement.
privacy_page.cookies_text: The website may use cookies or similar technologies where necessary for functionality, preferences, analytics or other legitimate website purposes.
privacy_page.third_party_text: AgeVerse may rely on third-party services for hosting, analytics, security and other website functionality. Those services may process information according to their own policies.
privacy_page.security_text: AgeVerse takes reasonable measures to support the security and reliability of the website, although no internet service can guarantee absolute security.
privacy_page.changes_text: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time to reflect changes to the website, services or applicable requirements.
privacy_page.contact_text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or AgeVerse's privacy practices, please contact the AgeVerse team.

terms_page.calculator_text: AgeVerse calculators are provided for general informational and educational purposes. You are responsible for reviewing the information you enter and the results you receive.
terms_page.accuracy_text: AgeVerse aims to provide useful and reliable calculations, but results may vary because of assumptions, rounding, input quality or differences in real-world conditions.
terms_page.health_text: Health-related calculator results are informational only and are not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
terms_page.financial_text: Financial calculator results are estimates for general informational purposes and should not be treated as financial, investment, banking or tax advice.
terms_page.pet_text: Pet calculator results are approximate educational estimates and should not replace advice from a qualified veterinary professional.
terms_page.availability_text: AgeVerse may update, modify, suspend or discontinue website features or calculators when necessary.
terms_page.responsibility_text: Users are responsible for using the website appropriately and for making decisions based on information from suitable professional or authoritative sources when required.
terms_page.changes_text: These Terms & Conditions may be updated from time to time. Continued use of AgeVerse after an update indicates acceptance of the revised terms.
terms_page.contact_text: For questions about these Terms & Conditions, please contact the AgeVerse team.

disclaimer_page.notice_text: Calculator results should be treated as estimates. They may differ from results produced by official institutions, professionals, banks, healthcare providers or other authoritative sources.
disclaimer_page.accuracy_text: AgeVerse uses defined calculation methods, but results can vary because of rounding, assumptions, input values and differences in real-world rules or conditions.
disclaimer_page.health_text: Health-related calculations are not medical advice and should not be used to diagnose, treat or prevent a medical condition. Consult an appropriately qualified healthcare professional when needed.
